### CVE-2001-0042
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2004-09-01 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20466: Apache 1.3 + PHP 3 - File Disclosure (remote/multiple, 2000-12-06, verified=1)

PHP 3.x (PHP3) on Apache 1.3.6 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a modified .. (dot dot) attack containing "%5c" (encoded backslash) sequences.

### CVE-2001-0590
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-03-09 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20716: Apache Tomcat 3.0 - Directory Traversal (remote/windows, 2001-03-28, verified=1)

Apache Software Foundation Tomcat Servlet prior to 3.2.2 allows a remote attacker to read the source code to arbitrary 'jsp' files via a malformed URL request which does not end with an HTTP protocol specification (i.e. HTTP/1.0).

### CVE-2001-0925
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-02-02 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20692: Apache 1.3 - Artificially Long Slash Path Directory Listing (1) (remote/multiple, 2001-06-13, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 20693: Apache 1.3 - Artificially Long Slash Path Directory Listing (2) (remote/multiple, 2002-02-21, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 20694: Apache 1.3 - Artificially Long Slash Path Directory Listing (3) (remote/multiple, 2001-06-13, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 20695: Apache 1.3 - Artificially Long Slash Path Directory Listing (4) (remote/multiple, 2001-06-13, verified=1)

The default installation of Apache before 1.3.19 allows remote attackers to list directories instead of the multiview index.html file via an HTTP request for a path that contains many / (slash) characters, which causes the path to be mishandled by (1) mod_negotiation, (2) mod_dir, or (3) mod_autoindex.

- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-02-02 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 21112: RedHat Linux 7.0 Apache - Remote Username Enumeration (remote/linux, 2001-09-12, verified=1)

Apache on Red Hat Linux with with the UserDir directive enabled generates different error codes when a username exists and there is no public_html directory and when the username does not exist, which could allow remote attackers to determine valid usernames on the server.
